summary: InPoint Commercial Real Estate Income, Inc. filed an 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose its monthly NAV per share calculation as of April 30, 2026. The filing provides a breakdown of net asset value components, showing aggregate NAV attributable to common stock of $135.6 million, or $13.4029 per share on 10.12 million shares outstanding. It also notes the termination of its public offering as of November 1, 2025. The filing is a routine periodic NAV disclosure with no transactional event, board recommendation, or special-situation catalyst. This is an informational update without M&A, restructuring, or capital-return implications. What to watch: continued monthly NAV updates for trend analysis; no risk-arb angle.
